scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');const roots=['packages','apps'];const workspaces=roots.flatMap((d)=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).filter((e)=>e.isDirectory()&&fs.existsSync(d+'/'+e.name+'/package.json')).map((e)=>d+'/'+e.name):[]);if(workspaces.length===0){console.log('No workspace packages found; skipping build.');process.exit(0)}for(const workspace of workspaces){if(process.platform==='win32'){cp.execFileSync('cmd.exe',['/d','/s','/c',`npm run build -w ${workspace} --if-present`],{stdio:'inherit'})}else{cp.execFileSync('npm',['run','build','-w',workspace,'--if-present'],{stdio:'inherit'})}}"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');const has=['apps','packages'].some((d)=>fs.existsSync(d)&&fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).some((e)=>e.isDirectory()&&fs.existsSync(d+'/'+e.name+'/package.json')));if(!has){console.log('No workspace packages found; skipping tests.');process.exit(0)}if(process.platform==='win32'){cp.execFileSync('cmd.exe',['/d','/s','/c','npm run test --workspaces --if-present'],{stdio:'inherit'})}else{cp.execFileSync('npm',['run','test','--workspaces','--if-present'],{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.test:watch: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');const has=['apps','packages'].some((d)=>fs.existsSync(d)&&fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).some((e)=>e.isDirectory()&&fs.existsSync(d+'/'+e.name+'/package.json')));if(!has){console.log('No workspace packages found; skipping test watch.');process.exit(0)}if(process.platform==='win32'){cp.execFileSync('cmd.exe',['/d','/s','/c','npm run test:watch --workspaces --if-present'],{stdio:'inherit'})}else{cp.execFileSync('npm',['run','test:watch','--workspaces','--if-present'],{stdio:'inherit'})}"
